# RecurSaathi

> Revenue recovery for Indian subscription businesses. RecurSaathi monitors failed card and UPI payments, retries inside RBI's allowed windows, sends WhatsApp and email nudges with one-tap UPI payment links, and chases overdue invoices and dormant customers. 14-day free trial, no card needed.

Key facts:
- Pricing: Starter ₹999/mo, Growth ₹4,999/mo, Enterprise ₹5,999/mo; annual billing at 10 months' price (₹9,990 / ₹49,990 / ₹59,990); prices exclude 18% GST.
- Works without a gateway: manual UPI mode collects on your own UPI handle with a QR, zero fees, no KYC; Razorpay AutoPay integration optional.
- Never holds customer money: payments settle directly into the business's own Razorpay account or UPI ID.
- RBI-compliant retries: 24-hour, 72-hour and day-7 windows, routed by decline code, never blind-retried on invalid cards; signature-verified webhooks.
- AI agent calls: one polite daily call per overdue invoice with the payment link and a promise-to-pay note.
- Other features: Recovery Radar (overdue, dormant, decline reasons), revenue analytics, invoices and public payment pages, customer payment portal, segmentation and reactivation, customer opt-outs honored automatically.
- Built for: edtech and coaching, fitness and studios, D2C subscriptions, agencies and services.
- Made in India, live since 2026. Contact: recursathi@gmail.com
